title: Digital Sovereignty Becomes an Imperative as the US Reads Dutch Emails
summary: This article discusses the growing importance of digital sovereignty as concerns arise about US government access to Dutch communications, highlighting the geopolitical tensions around data privacy and cross-border surveillance in the digital age.
problem_solved: Addresses the increasing risk of foreign government surveillance on a nation's digital communications infrastructure.
why_valuable: Brings critical attention to the urgent need for countries to establish independent digital infrastructure as cloud services increasingly fall under foreign jurisdictions.
